stories.title: Pinned OpenTUI native ABI and no-JS executable spike
stories.journey: Build the owned Zig fork and call its actual renderer from a minimal Rust executable; decide bridge versus rewrite using measured evidence.
tests: A Rust executable creates, draws, resizes and destroys a real native renderer without Node/Bun.
Generated or maintained C ABI matches exported symbols, struct sizes, alignment and integer widths.
Invalid/stale handles and null/oversized buffers fail predictably under native sanitizers where supported.
Build records fork commit, Zig version, flags, transitive native dependencies and license notices.
Compare startup/RSS/frame cost and missing high-level behavior; reject claiming the TS orchestration is only a bridge.

stories.title: Safe Rust ownership wrapper and terminal event lifecycle
stories.journey: Wrap audited FFI with safe lifetimes, one renderer owner and bounded input/events into Tokio while restoring the terminal on all supported exits.
tests: Create/drop cycles free renderer, buffers and callbacks exactly once.
Resize/input bursts use bounded queues without async executor starvation.
Cross-thread misuse is prevented by types or explicit checked ownership.
Cancellation and errors restore terminal modes and join all owned tasks.
Domain crates retain forbid(unsafe_code); unsafe operations remain isolated with documented invariants.

stories.title: Real native application shell connected to the daemon
stories.journey: Render an interactive native session/composer/sidebar/status shell backed by authenticated daemon state, replacing line-echo behavior.
tests: Real PTY input changes focus and renders native frames from daemon data.
Empty/loading/offline/error states are distinguishable and actionable.
Tiny and resized terminals do not overlap, panic or hide the focused control.
Network disconnect shows stale/offline state without presenting fake live data.
Render loop coalesces events, is idle when unchanged and keeps bounded retained history.

stories.title: Unicode composer, keymaps, paste and submission
stories.journey: Users compose multiline prompts, navigate/edit graphemes, paste safely, queue drafts and submit using configurable keys.
tests: Tamil, combining marks, emoji and wide characters edit and wrap without byte-boundary corruption.
Bracketed paste never auto-executes embedded commands or submits unintended lines.
Enter/Ctrl-J bindings, selection, undo and multiline navigation work through real input events.
Busy-session queue and interrupt preserve drafts with bounded admission.
Very large paste is rejected/truncated by explicit policy without terminal corruption or unbounded allocation.

stories.title: Streaming transcript, Markdown, code and diff presentation
stories.journey: Show streamed prose/reasoning/tool states, timestamps, code blocks and reviewable diffs with usable scrolling and copy actions.
tests: Partial Markdown/code tokens converge to the final correctly styled transcript.
Tool approval/running/failed/completed states match real engine events.
ANSI/OSC and hostile hyperlink content cannot escape rendering or silently access clipboard.
Scrollback/selection remain stable while tokens arrive and sessions switch.
Long transcripts are virtualized and obey frame-time/memory targets on a measured host.

stories.title: Palette, model/effort selection, settings and themes
stories.journey: Choose models/providers/effort, invoke commands and change themes/settings from keyboard and supported mouse interactions.
tests: Searchable palette executes actual registered commands instead of static labels.
Selecting a model/effort changes the next provider request and survives restart.
Main and child agent effort settings remain independent.
Theme contrast, no-color fallback and terminal palette changes remain readable.
Disabled/unavailable commands explain constraints and cannot bypass permissions.

stories.title: Session tabs, project navigation and subagent inspection
stories.journey: Navigate many sessions/workspaces and parent/child agent histories; fork, resume or steer the selected session without losing its draft.
tests: Tabs keep independent drafts, scroll positions, selected model and correct session routing.
Child session navigation shows persisted independent history and parent provenance.
Fork/resume actions invoke the actual service and display resulting session IDs.
Concurrent rename/archive events update navigation without switching to the wrong session.
Bounded tab/session lists paginate and closing a tab does not kill daemon-owned work.

stories.title: Approval, interruption, retry and error interaction
stories.journey: Review the exact proposed operation and scope, approve/deny safely, interrupt work and recover from errors using native UI controls.
tests: Permission dialog binds approval to operation digest, workspace, requester, expiry and policy version.
Stale/replayed approval is rejected without side effects.
Interrupt cancels the real in-flight operation and updates all clients.
Retry distinguishes safe retry from ambiguous completed side effects.
Keyboard focus cannot accidentally approve destructive or human-only actions.

stories.title: Live status, context, memory and tool/service controls
stories.journey: Inspect actual usage/cache/context/memory, account quota and MCP/tool state, with searchable controls backed by the daemon.
tests: Usage and cache counters originate from normalized provider events, not fixed zero values.
Memory/context views identify sources and enforce read/visibility policy.
MCP enable/disable/search controls change the real service lifecycle.
Quota/routing fallback and connectivity changes render accurate actionable states.
Refresh and idle operation respect event/retention budgets without continuous full polling.

stories.title: Native terminal parity and platform acceptance
stories.journey: Exercise the complete native terminal experience and compare audited OpenCode interactions on supported real terminal/platform combinations.
tests: Linux/macOS PTY and supported Windows console runs cover startup, compose, tools, tabs and quit.
Resize, IME/paste, Unicode, mouse, clipboard and terminal fallback scenarios have recorded outcomes.
Unexpected exit restores shell usability; no leaked renderer allocations or background callbacks remain.
Normalized interaction scenarios match the pinned reference or approved documented deviations.
Startup, idle CPU, RSS and streaming frame cost include all native dependencies and child processes.

stories.title: Minimal fork build and reproducible native distribution
stories.journey: Package only required native capabilities while retaining all requested product functionality and a maintainable pinned fork update process.
tests: Native build succeeds from pinned sources without npm/Bun lifecycle scripts.
Optional audio/image/embedded-terminal dependencies are included only when required by the audited feature profile.
Released binary resolves all native libraries on a clean target without developer toolchains.
Fork upgrade checks exported ABI and replays Unicode/rendering regression fixtures before pin changes.
SBOM/license/checksum artifacts identify transitive dependencies and no proprietary font files are bundled accidentally.
